title: Cohen-Macaulayness is stable under a flat base change of the target
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if a base change Y' -> Y is flat at the image of a point and the pulled-back morphism is Cohen-Macaulay there, then the original morphism is Cohen-Macaulay at the point. The proof reduces to the corresponding statement for the local rings, where the flatness hypothesis licenses the comparison of depths, and then reads Cohen-Macaulayness off the equality of dimension and depth. The comparison of depths along the flat local map is the step that carries the content. Retained author proof at lines 6385-6400.
